wordHints.Love: In tennis, love means a score of zero. It is one of the sport's most distinctive scoring terms.
wordHints.All: All is used when both players have the same score, as in 15-all or 30-all.
wordHints.Advantage: After a deuce (40-40), the player who wins the next point gains the "advantage." If they win the following point, they win the game.
wordHints.Fifteen: Represents the first point won in a game. A player's score progresses from love (0) to 15, then 30, then 40.
wordHints.Deuce: Deuce is the term for when the score is tied at 40-40. A player must win two consecutive points from deuce to secure the game.
